error_not_organization_member: You are not a member of this organization.
error_team_member_not_found: This member is not on the team.
error_entry_id_taken: An entry with this id already exists.
error_entry_forbidden: Only admins can change other members' entries.
error_entries_forbidden: You cannot see this member's entries.
error_entry_running: Stop a running entry with the timer.
error_entry_end_before_start: The end must be after the start.
error_entry_limit: You have too many entries around this time. Delete some first.
error_timer_started_elsewhere: Another timer was started at the same time.
error_timer_running_in_left_organization: Your timer is still running in an organization you left. Ask an admin there to delete it.
error_project_id_taken: A project with this id already exists.
error_project_name_taken: A project with this name already exists.
error_project_has_entries: This project has time entries. Archive it instead.
error_project_limit: This organization has too many projects. Delete unused ones first.
error_team_report_forbidden: You can report only on teams you lead.
validation_time_zone_format: Use a time zone such as Europe/Tallinn.
validation_end_before_start: The end must be after the start.
validation_range_end_before_start: The range must end after it starts.
validation_range_too_long: The range can span at most {days} days.
validation_member_or_team: Pick a member or a team, not both.
validation_slug_format: Use lowercase letters, numbers, and dashes.
auth_tagline: Winter is coming. So is the end of the month.
sign_in_description: Use your work account. The first sign-in creates your Snowtime account.
sign_in_error_failed: Sign-in didn't finish. Try again or use another method.
invitation_description: {inviter} invited {email} to join {as}. Continue with the account that uses this address.
invitation_wrong_title: This invitation is for another address
invitation_wrong_description: You're signed in as {current}, but {inviter} invited {email}.
invitation_wrong_hint: Or ask {inviter} for a new link to the address you use.
invitation_expired_description: Invitations are valid for 48 hours. Ask {inviter} or another admin of {organization} to send a new one.
invitation_closed_title: This invitation is no longer open
invitation_closed_description: It was accepted, declined, or canceled. If you still need access, ask an admin of the organization for a new link.
create_org_description: An organization holds your projects, teams, and time. You can invite people after this step.
create_org_slug_hint: Lowercase letters, numbers, and dashes. Used in links.
create_org_join_description: Ask its admin for an invitation link for {email}, then open it.
settings_preferences_description: Saved to your account and used on every device. Changes save right away.
settings_preview_device_zone: This device is in {zone}. Times show in your saved zone.
settings_show_summary_description: Today and this week beside the timer.
settings_profile_description: Your name and sign-in methods, the same in every organization.
settings_picture_hint: The picture comes from your sign-in provider.
settings_email_hint: Can't be changed: invitations are matched to this verified address.
settings_sign_in_methods_description: Any linked method signs you in to this account. Keep at least one.
settings_disconnect_description: You won't be able to sign in with {provider} until you connect it again.
settings_link_error_email: That account uses a different email address. Connect an account with the address of your Snowtime profile.
settings_link_error_taken: That account already signs in to another Snowtime account.
settings_password_detail: Seeded users only. Deployed environments sign in with a provider.
settings_passkey_detail: Sign in with your device's fingerprint, face, or screen lock.
settings_passkey_add_failed: The passkey wasn't added. Try again.
settings_passkey_remove_description: {name} will no longer sign you in. Remove it from your device or password manager too.
settings_session_not_fresh: For your security, sign out and sign in again, then try once more.
timer_running_elsewhere: Running in {organization}. Switch to it to edit this entry.
timer_empty_description: Start the timer above. Entries appear here grouped by day.
entry_error_missing: Enter a date, start and end time.
entry_error_missing_running: Enter a date and start time.
entry_error_future: An entry can't end in the future.
entry_error_running_future: A running entry can't start in the future.
projects_subtitle_member: The projects you can track time on in {organization}
projects_empty_admin: Projects group time for reports. Create one for the whole organization, or limit it to teams.
projects_empty_member: Time can still be tracked without a project. Ask an admin to create projects.
projects_empty_archived_description: Archive a finished project to keep its time in reports while nobody can track new time on it.
projects_footnote_admin: Projects without teams are open to the whole organization. Projects with teams are open to their members, and always to admins and owners.
projects_footnote_member: Admins and owners create and change projects. You see the ones open to the whole organization and to your teams.
projects_dialog_edit_description: Changes apply to its existing time too.
projects_dialog_archived_description: This project is archived. You can still rename it or change its teams.
projects_teams_hint_none: No teams: the whole organization can track time on it.
projects_teams_hint_some: Only members of {teams} can track time on it, plus admins and owners.
projects_no_teams: No teams yet, so the whole organization can track time on it.
projects_name_taken_archived: An archived project is called {name}. Restore it, or pick another name.
projects_archive_description: Nobody can track new time on it. Its time stays in reports, and you can restore it from Archived.
projects_delete_description: Delete is for projects created by mistake. Its name becomes free to use again.
projects_has_time_description: Projects with time entries can’t be deleted, so their time keeps its project. Archive it instead: nobody can track new time on it, and its time stays in reports.
projects_has_time_archived: Projects with time entries can’t be deleted, so their time keeps its project. It stays archived.
reports_team_note: Teams count the time of their current members, so someone in two teams counts in both and team totals can add up to more than the total.
reports_empty_title: No time tracked in this range.
reports_empty_description: Pick another range or other people.

match.countPlural=one: Your time and the time of the {teams} team, which you lead.
match.countPlural=*: Your time and the time of the {teams} teams, which you lead.

reports_zone_monday: Days and weeks in {zone}, starting Monday
reports_zone_sunday: Days and weeks in {zone}, starting Sunday
error_already_invited: This address already has an open invitation.
error_already_member: This person is already a member.
error_invitation_limit: This organization has too many open invitations. Cancel some first.
error_member_limit: This organization has reached its member limit.
error_team_limit: This organization has too many teams. Delete unused ones first.
error_organization_limit: You belong to too many organizations to create another.
error_last_owner: An organization needs at least one owner. Make someone else an owner first.
error_member_forbidden: Only owners can change or remove an owner.
error_organization_forbidden: Only admins and owners manage the organization.
organization_no_access_title: Only admins and owners manage the organization
organization_no_access_description: Ask an admin to change roles, teams, or invitations.
organization_lock_last_owner: The only owner. Make someone else an owner first.
organization_lock_self: You can't change your own role.
organization_lock_owner: Only owners can change an owner.
organization_members_footnote: Owners can change any role. Admins manage members and admins but not owners. An organization always keeps at least one owner.
organization_remove_member_description: They lose access to {organization} and leave all its teams. Their tracked time stays in reports.
organization_invitations_intro: Snowtime sends no email. Copy an invitation link and send it yourself. A link works for 48 hours, for whoever signs in with the invited address.
organization_invitations_empty_descripti: Invite someone to get a link you can send them.
organization_invitation_expires_soon: Expires in less than an hour
organization_invite_description: You get a link to send. It works for 48 hours.
organization_invite_email_hint: They must sign in with this address to accept.
organization_invite_already_invited: {email} already has an open invitation. Copy its link from the list.
organization_invite_link_description: Send this link to {email}. It works until {until}.
organization_teams_intro: Teams group people for access and reports. Leads see and report on their team's time. Projects stay with the organization when a team is deleted.
organization_teams_empty_description: Everyone tracks time on the organization's projects without teams. Create a team to give it a lead and its own projects.

match.countPlural=one: {count} member leaves the team but stays in the organization, and their time stays in reports.
match.countPlural=*: {count} members leave the team but stay in the organization, and their time stays in reports.

match.countPlural=one: {projects} then becomes available to the whole organization.
match.countPlural=*: {projects} then become available to the whole organization.

organization_general_description: The organization's name, shown in the switcher and in invitations.
organization_slug_hint: Set when the organization was created. It can't change.
organization_no_delete: Organizations can't be deleted, so their time history and audit trail stay intact.
